name: Dinka Giga Mix — Transition 01->02 (Reverse Engineered)
description: Recreating the first transition from the Dinka Giga Mix. Track 01 (127 BPM) and Track 02 (128 BPM) both stretched to 130 BPM (mix tempo). F minor (4A). Structural blend: Track 01's natural outro fades under Track 02's minimal intro.

tracks.name: Dinka — On The Beach (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 5:23 total. Key: F minor (4A). First downbeat at bar 5 (~10.05s, ambient intro before). Natural outro/breakdown near end. Published BPM 127, stretched to mix BPM 130.

tracks.name: Dinka — Asylum (Original Mix)
tracks.notes: 7:36 total. Key: F minor (4A). Downbeat phase=2. Published BPM 128, stretched to mix BPM 130. Phase-corrected: -2074 samples (46ms) via kick cross-correlation alignment.

transitions.notes: v3: Outgoing held at unity, incoming ramps gradually from 0.3 to 1.0. Mimics a DJ slowly bringing Track 02's fader up while Track 01's natural breakdown handles the exit. Similar approach to DJ Set 1.
